[Start Playbook](command:atOpsAgent.pickPlaybook)
config.discovery.mode: When to use tool discovery (search-then-load) instead of exposing every tool to the model: 'auto' switches on when the tool count exceeds the threshold, 'always' forces it on, 'off' disables it.
config.discovery.threshold: Tool count above which discovery mode kicks in when 'atOpsAgent.discovery.mode' is 'auto'.
config.plugins.autoEnableNew: Automatically enable newly discovered capability plugins without asking.
config.approval.sessionRequiredFor: Which risk levels require an in-chat session approval before a tool runs: write and exec operations, exec only, or never (plugin-side approvals still apply).
config.approval.dedupePluginModal: Skip the capability plugin's own confirmation modal when the session approval already covers the same command set (uses HMAC approval tokens).
config.approval.sessionReadAllowlist: Tool name prefixes treated as read-only for this machine; matching tools bypass session approval. Example: ["kb.", "metrics.query"].
config.approval.timeoutMs: Pending-approval timeout in milliseconds. Timed-out requests are treated as rejected and the session is released. 0 disables the timeout.
config.models.defaultThinkingLevel: Default reasoning effort requested from models that support it.
config.models.toolCallPromptFallback: Emulate tool calling through prompts for models without native tool/function calling.
config.workspaceShell.enabled: Allow read-only workspace file access (cwd-bound, 64KB). Off by default. Does not enable a shell.
config.subagent.maxParallel: Maximum number of subagents that may run in parallel within one session.
config.sessions.maxParallel: Maximum number of chat sessions that may run agent loops concurrently. 1 keeps a single active run; 2 allows starting a prompt in another session while the first is busy.
config.streaming.batchMs: Milliseconds to batch streaming deltas before pushing them to the chat view (0 disables batching).
config.inspection.intervalMinutes: If greater than 0, remind every N minutes to run the inspection playbook (pb.inspection). 0 disables the reminder.
config.im.webhookUrl: Optional IM webhook URL (e.g. WeCom/DingTalk/Slack incoming webhook). When set, pending approval requests post a JSON summary there. No secrets are sent.
